description: Canonical patterns for discovering Luma annotations in source files. The VS Code extension is generated from this file (extensions/vscode/src/generated/test-discovery.ts) because it discovers annotations with regular expressions. The tree-sitter based Zed extension implements the SAME contract natively and cannot consume these regexes: Zed (languages/luma/runnables.scm) uses tree-sitter queries instead. Update every implementation in tandem when the annotation or function-declaration grammar changes.

test_function.description: Matches an @test-annotated function declaration. Capture group 1 is the function name. Allows preceding annotations and an optional generic/qualified return type.

test_annotation.description: Matches a standalone @test annotation line (the file contains tests).

main_annotation.description: Matches a standalone @main annotation line (the file is runnable).
